questions.question: Which actor plays Marion Ravenwood opposite Harrison Ford in Raiders of the Lost Ark?
questions.note: Allen plays Indy’s former lover Marion Ravenwood in Raiders and returns in the later films.

questions.question: Which actor plays nightclub singer Willie Scott in Temple of Doom?
questions.note: Capshaw plays Willie, who escapes Shanghai with Indy and Short Round.

questions.question: Which actor plays Rachel Lapp opposite Harrison Ford in Witness?
questions.note: McGillis plays the Amish widow who shelters Ford’s wounded detective, John Book.

questions.question: Who plays Sabrina Fairchild opposite Harrison Ford in the 1995 remake of Sabrina?
questions.note: Ormond takes the role Audrey Hepburn played in the 1954 original. Ford plays Linus Larrabee.

questions.question: Which actor plays Tess McGill’s boss, Katharine Parker, in Working Girl?
questions.note: Weaver plays the executive who steals Tess’s merger idea. Ford plays investment broker Jack Trainer.

questions.question: Which actor plays submarine officer Mikhail Polenin opposite Ford in K-19: The Widowmaker?
questions.note: Neeson’s Polenin serves under Ford’s Captain Vostrikov aboard the Soviet submarine.

questions.question: Who directed K-19: The Widowmaker?
questions.note: Bigelow directed Ford and Liam Neeson in the 2002 submarine drama.

questions.question: Which actor plays the IRA gunman living under Ford’s roof in The Devil’s Own?
questions.note: Pitt plays Rory Devaney, whose real name is Frankie McGuire. Ford plays NYPD officer Tom O’Meara.

questions.question: Which actor plays Officer K opposite Ford in Blade Runner 2049?
questions.note: Gosling’s K tracks down Ford’s missing Rick Deckard in the 2017 sequel.

questions.question: Which actor plays young Indiana Jones in the opening of The Last Crusade?
questions.note: Phoenix plays teenage Indy during the circus-train chase that explains the scar, whip, and fedora.
